key_headlines.title: Tax Expenditures Reach Historic 100 Trillion Won as Corporate Tax Breaks Expand
key_headlines.summary: Tax expenditures including tax-free provisions and tax credits are expected to exceed 100 trillion won for the first time, with semiconductor R&D and investment deductions accounting for approximately half of all corporate tax benefits.

key_headlines.title: Experts Warn of Fiscal Sustainability Risks if Semiconductor Boom Ends
key_headlines.summary: While the government plans to maintain national debt-to-GDP ratio around 48-50% through 2030, economists express concerns about future fiscal rigidity and generational burden if semiconductor cycle deteriorates.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's 2027 budget has reached an unprecedented 821 trillion won, fueled by booming semiconductor industry tax revenues projected to hit 584 trillion won—a 40% increase from 2026. The government is establishing a new 162 trillion won future response fund to invest strategically in AI, youth employment, and regional development. Corporate tax alone is expected to surge 114%, while tax expenditures are breaking the 100 trillion won ceiling for the first time, with semiconductor-related deductions dominating. This 'semiconductor-driven expansionary fiscal' approach aims to balance economic growth with fiscal consolidation, though experts question long-term sustainability if the semiconductor supercycle ends.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The government's 821 trillion won budget represents record-breaking fiscal expansion, with tax revenues surging due to semiconductor boom-driven corporate tax increases. The Bank of Korea is simultaneously pursuing contractionary monetary policy with consecutive interest rate hikes, creating policy discord concerns as rising borrowing expectations could fuel inflation. The government projects managing national debt-to-GDP ratio at approximately 48-50% through 2030, assuming sustained semiconductor growth and economic expansion. However, economists warn that if the semiconductor cycle weakens, tax revenues and growth rates could both deteriorate simultaneously, creating fiscal rigidity challenges with growing mandatory expenditures. The structural mismatch between expansionary fiscal and contractionary monetary policy raises concerns about policy effectiveness.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI index is consolidating around the 7,000-level while fluctuating due to uncertainties surrounding U.S. interest rate trajectory and geopolitical tensions. U.S. Treasury yields have reached 19-month highs, with CME FedWatch data showing 65.4% probability of a 25 basis point rate hike at the September FOMC meeting. The won-dollar exchange rate is hovering around 1,368-1,370 won, reflecting global rate uncertainties and financial market volatility. Oil price fluctuations and interest rate concerns are weighing on Korean equity markets, while major financial institutions continue monitoring U.S. employment data and Federal Reserve policy signals for market direction.
sections.Industry & Technology: The semiconductor export sector is driving South Korea's industrial momentum, with semiconductor exports reaching 47.5% of total exports in August at 983 billion dollars—the highest proportion on record. Techros Water & Energy is accelerating advanced industry wastewater treatment projects, securing contracts exceeding 800 billion won from SK Hynix and other semiconductor and display manufacturers. SK Innovation is experiencing strong stock performance driven by large-scale U.S. energy storage system supply contracts for its battery subsidiary SK On and improved refining margins. The government's 2027 budget allocates significant resources to AI semiconductor development, K-chemical industry transformation, and AI-based industrial safety management systems across major manufacturing sectors.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's apartment transaction market shows significant contraction, with apartment supply volume down 48% in the first half of 2026 compared to the previous year, while monthly lease transactions jumped by 6.5 percentage points as affordability pressures mount. Mortgage interest rates are approaching 8% annually, with major banks' five-year fixed mortgage rates reaching 4.68-7.15%, causing stress among debt-leveraged homebuyers amid consecutive central bank rate hikes. The shift from sales to monthly rentals accelerates the transition toward rental-dependent housing markets, particularly among younger demographics facing affordability challenges. Apartment prices show strong Northern Seoul appreciation, with some premium areas like Gyeonghuigung Zi recording record 5 million won monthly rental rates despite overall price softening in Southern Seoul.
sections.International Economy: The U.S. Federal Reserve faces internal division over monetary policy direction, with Fed Chair Jerome Powell signaling hawkish inclinations toward rate hikes while President Trump continues pressuring for rate cuts, claiming U.S. rates are excessive. The CME FedWatch reflects 65.4% probability of a 25 basis point rate hike at the September FOMC meeting, indicating market expectations of continued Fed tightening. Global interest rate momentum is being reinforced by Powell's Jackson Hole speech emphasizing inflation concerns, creating headwinds for emerging markets including South Korea. Trump's administration is pursuing growth-focused economic policies to address high debt and high-rate concerns, creating policy uncertainty in global financial markets and potentially complicating South Korea's export-dependent economic strategy.
sections.AI & Economy: The government's 2027 budget designates 2027 as 'AI Korea's founding year,' launching three mega-projects: semiconductor, AI data center, and physical AI initiatives with concentrated investment in the sector. Key budget allocations include 90 billion won for market-driven K-AI semiconductor full-stack reference development and support services for SME AI threat responses. The 200 trillion won National Growth Fund is focusing on advanced industries including AI and semiconductors over five years, addressing Korea's need for competitive AI infrastructure in global markets. Policy discussions emphasize shifting from short-term sales-focused export support to brand-building strategies where AI shopping platforms and consumer recommendation systems will drive future competitiveness before human purchasing decisions.
sections.Others: The Financial Supervisory Service is strengthening regulations against fraudulent financial investment advertising on YouTube and other platforms by requiring Chief Compliance Officer review procedures and establishing new advertising review committees. Construction worker daily wages hit 282,737 won with only 1.4% year-on-year growth—the lowest rate in 10 years—reflecting prolonged construction industry downturn and weakened wage pressure. South Korea's decentralized derivatives exchange Hyperliquid is pursuing U.S. market entry through Kraken's parent company Payward following Trump administration signals of support. Financial regulators are implementing comprehensive advertising procedure reforms to combat misleading ETF and financial product promotions that have proliferated on digital platforms.
